root_cause: 1) oh-my-opencode-slim.json pins paper-oc (and several other agents at lines 497/505/517/525) to model 'opencode/deepseek-v4-flash-free', which no longer exists in the provider registry (suggested: ling-3.0-flash-fin-free, ling-3.1-flash-free, mimo-v2.6-flash-free). 2) The librarian session exceeded its model context limit before producing output — session scope/context too large for one dispatch.
what_i_did_wrong: Dispatched a lane without pre-checking that the agent's configured model resolves. Sent a single large research prompt to librarian instead of splitting into smaller bounded slots.
remediation: Update paper-oc model in oh-my-opencode-slim.json to a resolvable model; re-dispatch paper revision (fresh session — errored sessions are not reusable). Split librarian reference research into two narrower bounded dispatches or reduce scope per dispatch. Write pm1-trace for the recovery task.
